title: Beast
wikitext:
A type of creature or [[mob]] in the game as distinguished from [[Humanoid|humanoids]]. This includes most animals and some fantastical creatures.

Examples of beasts:
* [[Cat]]s
* [[Bear|Bears]]
* [[Goretusk|Goretusks]], also known as [[Boar|boars]]
* Most birds
* [[Wolf|Wolves]]
